test_title: PYST 23: Selection Post (Higher Secondary Level) - English Language (Held On 15 Mar 2022 Shift 2)
subject: english
question:
Select the option that can be used as a one-word substitute for the given group of words.

Safe to drink
solution:
The correct answer is **"Potable".**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

 
• Let's see the meaning of "Safe to drink" and other words given in the options.

 
 
• Edible:- fit or suitable to be eaten

 
 
• Example:- There is a shortage of edible oil in the rural area.
 
 
 
• Potable:- safe to drink; drinkable
 
 
• Example:- Sri Lanka has a significant issue with potable water.
 
 
 
• Nutritious:- efficient as food; nourishing
 
 
• Example:- Nowadays children are avoiding nutritious food and preferring to fast food.
 
 
 
• Portable:- ​able to be easily carried or moved
 
 
• Example:- Portable devices are worthy as we can carry them anywhere.
 
 
 
 
 
• Hence, according to the meaning of the sentence, the correct answer is the option no 2 i.e Potable.
